# Capnp.jl

> Cap'n Proto data serialization and RPC for Julia: zero-copy reads straight out of message buffers, a native `capnpc-jl` compiler plugin that turns `.capnp` schemas into Julia code, and experimental support for the Cap'n Proto RPC protocol.

## Documentation
- [Home](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/)
- [Supported functionality](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/support/)
- [Serialization](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/api/)
- [RPC types](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/rpc/)
- [RPC functions](https://s-celles.github.io/Capnp.jl/dev/rpc-functions/)
